scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @field-atlas/shared && node scripts/run-apps.mjs dev
scripts.dev:web: npm run build --workspace @field-atlas/shared && npm run dev --workspace @field-atlas/web --
scripts.dev:api: npm run build --workspace @field-atlas/shared && npm run dev --workspace @field-atlas/api
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @field-atlas/shared && npm run build --workspace @field-atlas/api && npm run build --workspace @field-atlas/web
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @field-atlas/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
